👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
4 October 1957 ka din tha, jisne puri duniya ko ek naye war ke maidan mein dhakel diya. Hua kuch yun ki antariksh se ek chhoti si awaaz sunai di, aur is awaaz ne poori duniya ko hila kar rakh diya.
Soviet Union ne Sputnik launch kiya tha—jo ki duniya ka sabse pehla satellite tha, jo Prithvi ke chakkar laga raha tha. Aur ye world history me ek itihasic moment isliye maani jaati hai, kyunki itihas me pehli baar aisa hua ki kisi desh ne America ko peeche chod diya! Aur yahi se shuru hui, doston, America aur Soviet Union ke beech duniya ki sabse badi space war!
Aur doston, 2025 bhi ek aisa saal mana jayega jisne America ko ek jhatka diya, kyunki is baar phir ek desh ne America ko bata diya ki America world superpower zyada din tak nahi rahega! Aur ye jung shuru hui China ke DeepSeek AI se.
Doston, is ek launch ne American market ko aisa hila kar rakh diya ki jabse ye release hua tabse Nvidia ke stocks 19% gir gaye, Nasdaq Composite 4.3% gir gaya, aur poora Wall Street panic mode me aa chuka hai!
Aur jis tarah se is launch ne dhamaka kiya hai, isse dekh kar poori duniya ko samajh aa gaya hai ki duniya ke itihaas me ek aur yudh shuru ho chuka hai—aur is yudh ko itihaas AI War ke naam se yaad rakhega!
